title: Python for finance and financial modeling
audience: a college student in a finance, accounting or business degree program, or a career changer studying the same material on their own
purpose: Write clear, tested Python for financial work: time-value functions, cash-flow and loan models, data cleaning and analysis with tables of returns, three-statement and DCF models, scenario and sensitivity analysis, Monte Carlo simulation, and charts, using the standard library in the browser and pandas and NumPy on your own computer.
primary_reading: QuantEcon: Python Programming for Economics and Finance (free)

weeks.1: Python review for finance: functions and tests
weeks.5: Returns and risk from price data

blocks.deliverable: Write and test NPV, IRR and annuity functions.
Build an amortization schedule with dates.
Compute returns and volatility from a price file.
Week 7 midterm; forecast a balance sheet that balances.
Value a company and build a sensitivity grid.
Submit the project; take an unseen 120 minute final in week 14.

project: Model library: write a small, documented and tested Python package with time-value, loan, return, three-statement and DCF functions; use it to value a real company with a scenario and Monte Carlo analysis; and write a short user guide.
completion: finish the project, take the week 7 midterm and week 14 cumulative final, then complete a new cumulative assessment after 1 to 2 weeks. Explain one major idea aloud without notes.
